instruction: Validate Last-success, LKG, immutable Release, Current, Manifest and trade-authority identities before reading downstream outputs.
Create one deterministic run identity from cadence, effective as-of, source identities and event identity.
Require user-confirmed post-as-of real and simulation changes before treating an LKG snapshot as current.
Evaluate source as-of, market-session alignment, data grade and allowed use separately for each market and domain.
Run A-share, Hong Kong and US adapters independently and quarantine failed markets or domains.
Reconcile Security, Issuer, listing, A/H, ADR, share-class and duplicate-index exposure before comparisons.
Promote Current only after source, schema, quality, Manifest, replay and authority checks pass.
Review Candidate Core, Active Memo, triggers and re-entry routes without automatic membership changes.
Refresh thesis, catalyst, Prove/Kill and hard-review status with append-only decision logging.
Review no-add, hard-review, concentration, contribution and migration-readiness controls without automatic orders.
Apply explicit normalization and fail closed where factor, valuation, accounting, peer or attribution definitions differ.
Reconcile open-position, closed-position, fee, cash and total-account effects and preserve unavailable components explicitly.
Classify recurring failures and produce proposals only after multiple observations and regression requirements are met.
Refresh financial, valuation and research evidence under PIT, filing and source-grade controls.
Review strategy effectiveness, false positives, false negatives, operating costs, source resilience and governance rules.
Deduplicate events, register evidence, classify impact and route to observation, memo, hard review or human decision.
Preserve LKG, reject partial publication and recover from immutable Release before Current can be replaced.
Publish accepted control outputs, alert unresolved conditions and open only the next frozen gate.
